structured_output.what_is_happening: DDOSINU is a pump.fun token that is already trading on PumpSwap. It is about 14 minutes old, has a $136-140k market cap and about $33k of burned-LP liquidity, and did $252k of volume on about 3.8k buys against 750 sells. Price rose about 90% since the pair was created, then fell about 15-18% in the last 5 minutes. It is about 21% below its all-time high. Many dead DDOSINU copies exist, including a cluster launched about 5.5 hours earlier.

narrative.description: A generic Shiba/doge 'DDOS' meme ('internet-breaking chaos'). It has a website, an X account and a Telegram. It may be a relaunch of a DDOSINU ticker that already drew attention (and copycats) about 5.5 hours earlier.
narrative.why_spreading: Early momentum and a large number of small buyers, possibly carried over from the earlier DDOSINU wave. The packet shows no identifiable external catalyst.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the only DDOSINU with live liquidity and volume. It has a website, socials and a DexScreener profile, and GMGN shows the dev's X account launched 2 tokens.
token_connection.competing_tokens: About 10 same-name tokens with zero liquidity. Most were created about 5.5 hours earlier, and two BAGS-suffix copies appeared within minutes of this pair.

authenticity.evidence: About 2,723 unique buyers against 477 sellers in roughly 14 minutes, with an average buy of about $68. GMGN shows a low bot rate, 10 bundlers holding about 1%, no snipers, and no smart-money or KOL wallets. There is no paid promotion. However, 9 of the top 10 holders hold almost exactly 0.28% each (the top one holds 0.29%), a flat pattern typical of scripted multi-wallet buys. It has only 13 GMGN page visits, which is low next to 2.7k buyers.
authenticity.uncertainty: Without X or Telegram data I can't tell a real community from a holder-inflation bot farm.

structural_risks: Top holders are uniformly about 0.28%, which suggests a coordinated wallet cluster
Created and migrated at the same timestamp, which is unusual for a pump.fun launch
Liquidity is about $33k against a $140k market cap
About 20% below its all-time high, with negative 5-minute momentum at entry
Dev's previous best token peaked at about $178k

structured_output.counterargument: This may be the canonical relaunch of a meme that already had traction. That combination fits early runners, and the 5-minute dip may be a healthy entry before a push past $280k.

structured_output.thesis: The structure is clean and the unique-buyer breadth is strong, but a flat top-holder pattern and possibly inflated buy counts point to manufactured demand. It is entering after a 90% run and while fading off its high. Its chance of hitting 2x before -50% is slightly above the base rate for this pool, but it is not a standout.
